title_zh: Coupland α · Era Critic 脚本挑战模板（P1a）
voice_note: Speakable challenge lines derived from claim-map meaning. VoiceCard polish later (COPY_AGENT_CHARTER). P1a may ship with these + persona bans.

templates.text_zh: 大角未必需要集中电荷——弥散正电球里多次小偏转的尾部，也能凑出稀有大角。
templates.text_en: Large angles need not imply a concentrated charge — they may still be the compound-scattering tail inside a diffuse positive sphere.

templates.text_zh: 课堂主流仍是 Thomson 图景：均匀正电球加微粒。先别急着换整幅原子像。
templates.text_en: Classroom mainstream remains Thomson's uniform positive sphere with corpuscles — do not rush a whole new atom picture.
templates.notes: P1a priority. Rebut as C1 + labeled textbook fact-textbook-nuclear-model.

templates.text_zh: 即便有「漫反射」，也先别下结构判决——中心电荷顶多是工作假说。
templates.text_en: Even with diffuse reflection reported, withhold a structure verdict — central charge is only a working hypothesis.
templates.notes: P1a priority. Fill large-angle Facts first, then central-charge.

templates.text_zh: α 更像从外层离开或散射——大角不必逼出「极小中心」的故事。
templates.text_en: α may leave or scatter from the outer layers — large angles need not force a tiny-centre story.

templates.text_zh: 解释稀有大角 ≠ 完整原子论——电子排布与化学几乎未谈。
templates.text_en: Explaining rare large angles is not a full atomic theory — electrons and chemistry are barely addressed.
templates.notes: Extended. Tone challenge; does not require electron-model fill.

templates.text_zh: 若箔真极薄，大角本不该出现；若出现，更像厚靶、表面或杂质故事。
templates.text_en: If the foil is truly thin, large angles should not appear; if they do, prefer thick-target, surface, or impurity stories.
templates.notes: Extended. Rebut with thin-gold / 1-in-20000 Facts — no invented thicknesses.

templates.text_zh: 绝大多数几乎直行——所谓「折回」更像稀有噪声或读点误差。
templates.text_en: Most α go nearly straight — so-called turn-backs may be rare noise or spot-reading error.
templates.notes: P1a priority. Needs forward-majority + large-angle Facts together.

templates.text_zh: ZnS 肉眼计数与暗室几何太易漏光、眩光或看错——还谈不上真「反射」。
templates.text_en: ZnS eye-counting and dark-room geometry invite leak, glare, or misreads — not yet true reflection.
templates.notes: Extended. Rebut with ZnS method + geometry Facts.

templates.text_zh: 即便承认「集中电荷」，符号仍可正可负——勿当作已定论。
templates.text_en: Even granting a concentrated charge, the sign may still be ± — do not treat it as settled.
templates.notes: P1a priority. Fill concentration; do not lock sign from Critic.

templates.text_zh: 开口就说「原子核 / 行星原子」是后世词——先谈中心电荷。
templates.text_en: Opening with "nucleus / planetary atom" is anachronism — prefer central charge first.
templates.notes: P1a priority. Speech color only; fills use central-charge Facts.
